name: cue-desktop
description: Cue desktop app: live answer cues with direct system audio capture and a floating window hidden from screen sharing.

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cue listens to the conversation to show you live answer cues.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Cue hears the other side of your call so it can answer their questions.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: macOS requires screen-recording permission to capture system audio. Cue keeps the sound only.
